title: Percentage-based promo codes
body: Marketing wants to run promo campaigns. A promo is a code plus a percent_off value, applied to the merchandise subtotal. The pricing code needed some restructuring to keep this clean - shipping thresholds now evaluate against the discounted subtotal.

acceptance_criteria.text: order_total accepts an optional promo ({code, percent_off}) and applies the percentage to the subtotal before shipping is calculated.
The free-shipping threshold applies to the discounted subtotal.
Totals are unchanged when no promo is given.
